title: Runescape Dragonwilds - 1.0.1 New Movement Tech - Infinite Double Jump
author: Dotxy
description:
Building on my Jump Attack Cancel, you can chain the JAC into an extra jump in the air, and perform another Jump Attack while airborne

And over and over and over and over and over again

If you're faster than I am you can gain height, not just hover lol

comments.author: @brendonboyd7668
comments.text:
Just learned this and I’m on PS5
1- Set your spell wheel to where wind step is Triangle R1 input. Set your repair equipment spell to Traingle R2 for Righties or L2 for lefties.
2- Start off by practicing this pattern
Repair Spell, Cancel spell, double jump R1

3- Add wind step to the beginning of the pattern and boom 

I hope this is helpful!
Ps. You don’t need to re input windstep after the first time just keep the pattern from Step 2.

comments.author: @Dotxygaming
comments.text:
You can cancel a jump attack by opening the spell casting menu, then selecting a spell that requires you to target an area on the ground. After you bring up the spell you can close the spell ring interface then jump!

you can repeat this in the air an infinite amount of times

comments.text:
definitely still works! make sure you have a weapon equipped that can perform a jump attack, on PC I have the magical mending spell keybind set to 1 on my keyboard so my inputs look like this:

Windstep/Double jump -> left click (jump attack) -> Q (open spell ring) -> 1 -> escape (close spell ring) -> Jump

repeat as needed with another jump attack etc

there's a bit of a rhythm to find with the inputs but it's not too bad
